title: Intraday Serial Correlation and the Predictability of Returns in the U.S. Treasury Note Futures Market
authors: Patrick Cusatis; Mukund Kulkarni; Martin Thomas
summary: Owned ZN one-minute OHLC cannot reconstruct tick order,30-day tick autocorrelation or1/2-tick channel executions. Stop this route before a trial; no bar-frequency substitution.
about: Tick-scale Treasury-note price reversals and a channel strategy.
findings: Authors describe17,726,552price-change observations on1,077days2000–04 and profitable reversal rules. Full cost/fill results not reviewed or reproduced.
mechanism: Negative transaction-price correlation can reflect bid/ask movement; selling a recorded high is not proof a marketable sell can fill there.
build_on: Owned ZN one-minute OHLC cannot reconstruct tick order,30-day tick autocorrelation or1/2-tick channel executions. Stop this route before a trial; no bar-frequency substitution.
can_strategy_code_be_made: A tick event implementation is possible with matching data and full rules; our minute exports cannot faithfully implement it.
